metrics.note: band targets and the minimum sample size per band are TENTATIVE starting hypotheses (specs/PHASE-B.md §7.4), tuned on the first judged runs. The band-wise metric CHOICE itself is already settled (specs/PHASE-B.md §10 v1.1): ECE/Brier are inapplicable, not merely unchosen, because the three-band vocabulary carries no numeric confidence to score them against.
